_comment: UFV campus model: metadata.planning_model and metadata.local_routing describe how this JSON feeds PDDL (macro) vs in-floor instructions (micro).

metadata.coverage: G (3 floors, all-to-all), CD (cafeteria, gym), H (minimal)
metadata.planning_model: connections: macro graph for PDDL (building-floor topology). Action costs are defined in pddl/domain.pddl, not in JSON.
metadata.local_routing: local_connections: fine-grained walking instructions within one floor (natural language); optional BFS chains edges when no direct link exists.
